notes: Easy Setup: Mac: one “Odds & Whiskers Setup” app installs everything with clicks — it brings its own Python, so there’s no Terminal and no python.org step. A welcome wizard for new copies: practice mode, connecting your Kalshi account, moving money and switching to real money, all inside the app. Your Kalshi key can be set up in the app (Settings → Kalshi account). It’s stored encrypted on this computer and locked by the Mac Keychain or Windows Credential Manager — never uploaded, never shown again.
